## Projects
### Company Brain
Graph agent · FalkorDB · MCP | HACKATHON + BLOG
Problem: Answers about a company are scattered across people, systems and incidents, and an AI agent that cannot show its reasoning is hard to trust.
What I built: An agent that answers questions over a company knowledge graph in FalkorDB. Every answer shows the exact Cypher query it ran. Includes incident response, shared agent memory and an MCP interface.
Result: Submitted to Graph Hacks (FalkorDB x WeMakeDevs), live demo and video available
Built with: Python, FalkorDB, Cypher, MCP, Streamlit
My role: Built it (with Claude assistance, disclosed in the README)
Architecture: Question -> Agent -> Cypher on FalkorDB -> Answer + query
Live demo: https://terminatorcompanybrain.streamlit.app
Source: https://github.com/Swaroop29/company-brain
Write-up: https://dev.to/swaroop_patil_d9a2f9cb9de/when-the-event-bus-fails-building-company-brain-with-falkordb-21fm

### AI Campaign Analytics
AWS Lambda · Bedrock | AT AMAZON
Problem: Marketing performance reporting for EU Prime campaigns was a manual workflow for engineering and marketing teams.
What I built: Designed and deployed an AI-driven campaign analytics platform on AWS Lambda and Bedrock that automates the reporting.
Result: Replaced a manual reporting workflow
Built with: AWS Lambda, Amazon Bedrock
My role: Designed and deployed it (EU Prime Tech, Amazon)
Architecture: Campaign data -> Lambda -> Bedrock -> Reports


### InfluencerConnect
Bedrock · Claude · FastAPI | MVP
Problem: Brands find influencers by filtering spreadsheets and guessing at fit.
What I built: An agentic brand and influencer matching platform. Brands describe what they want in plain language and a RAG pipeline on Bedrock and Claude finds and ranks matches.
Result: MVP built
Built with: Amazon Bedrock, Claude, FastAPI, RAG
My role: Built it
Architecture: Brand request -> Agent -> RAG on Bedrock -> Ranked matches


### AI Interview Platform
Python · Flask · AWS | PRESENTED
Problem: Running and evaluating candidate interviews end to end, for many candidates at the same time.
What I built: An ML-powered interview evaluation system in Python and Flask on AWS, with anomaly detection and response-quality models.
Result: Presented at a national poster competition (2023)
Built with: Python, Flask, AWS, ML models
My role: Built the system
Architecture: Candidate session -> Flask API -> ML models -> Evaluation


### Green Hydrogen Optimiser
Full stack · Geospatial | MSC
Problem: Planning where to generate, store and transport green hydrogen across the UK, and what that costs.
What I built: A full-stack web app that simulates renewable energy generation, storage and transport across the UK, built around a geospatial cost-optimisation model.
Result: Cost-optimisation model and map views across the UK
Built with: GeoPandas, Cartopy, D3.js, Leaflet, Google Maps API
My role: Designed the geospatial cost-optimisation model
Architecture: Geo data -> Optimiser -> Web app -> Map views


### LendEase
React · Python · MongoDB · ML | HACKATHON WINNER
Problem: People without easy access to traditional banking, such as international students, low-income households and minorities, face high interest rates and collateral demands when they need money in an emergency.
What I built: A community-driven lending platform that pairs community lending networks with machine learning credit-assessment models, plus financial education features. Built with a React front end, a Python back end and MongoDB.
Result: Winner, Hack South West 2024. Written up in a published paper
Built with: React, Python, MongoDB, scikit-learn, TensorFlow
My role: Built it and wrote the paper
Architecture: Community -> Loan request -> ML credit model -> Decision


### This Portfolio
HTML · CSS · JS · CI | THIS SITE
Problem: A CV is a flat list. I wanted a recruiter, a manager and an engineer to each find what they need in under a minute, and I wanted proof the site keeps working.
What I built: A streaming-style portfolio with a profile picker, project pages, flip cards and an education timeline. Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript on Cloudflare Pages, with automated tests and a CI pipeline on every change.
Result: Every change is tested on desktop, tablet and phone profiles before it deploys
Built with: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Actions, Playwright, GoatCounter
My role: Designed and built it, working with Claude
Architecture: GitHub -> Tests (CI) -> Cloudflare Pages -> Live check
What I would do differently: A hand-edited change once broke the live site for about ten hours. Now every change is tested on real browsers and devices before it deploys, and a live-site check raises an alert if anything breaks.
Source: https://github.com/Swaroop29/portfolio
